env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 /workspace/hermes-factory/venvs/aodl-canary-next/bin/python -B - <<'PY'
import importlib.util
import json
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

test_path = Path("tests/test_golden_trace.py").resolve()
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("offline_golden_fixtures", test_path)
fixtures = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(fixtures)
cases = (
    ("false_exact_outcome", False, "exact_string_CANONICAL_OK", 100, 20),
    ("wrong_verifier_identity", True, "unrelated_fixture_verifier", 100, 20),
    ("boolean_usage", True, "exact_string_CANONICAL_OK", True, False),
    ("negative_usage", True, "exact_string_CANONICAL_OK", -1, -20),
)
results = []
for case, success, verifier, input_tokens, output_tokens in cases:
    receipts, _, tokenomics = fixtures.base_rows()
    physical = next(row for row in receipts if row.get("trace_id") == fixtures.PHYSICAL)
    physical["input_tokens"] = input_tokens
    physical["output_tokens"] = output_tokens
    outcomes = [{
        "trace_id": fixtures.PHYSICAL,
        "outcome_tier": "gold",
        "outcome": {"verified_success": success, "verification_source": verifier},
    }]
    proof = fixtures.G.collect(receipts, outcomes, tokenomics, fixtures.ROOT_TRACE)
    proof["root_trace_id"] = "remote-public-proof"
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="aodl-audit-negative-") as temp:
        bundle = Path(temp) / "synthetic-bundle"
        fixtures.make_bundle(bundle)
        (bundle / "golden-trace.json").write_text(json.dumps(proof) + "\n")
        try:
            fixtures.I.validate_bundle(bundle)
            imported_validation = "accepted"
        except Exception as exc:
            imported_validation = type(exc).__name__ + ": " + str(exc)
    results.append({
        "case": case,
        "structural_execution_complete": proof["structural_execution_complete"],
        "verified_outcome_complete": proof["verified_outcome_complete"],
        "usage_known": proof["checks"]["usage_known"],
        "actual_outcome_verified_success": success,
        "verification_source": verifier,
        "validate_bundle": imported_validation,
        "scope": "existing public synthetic fixtures; no import/publish CLI invoked",
    })
print(json.dumps(results, indent=2))
PY
